scope.reviewBoundary: The complete repeated acquire/release-versus-permission/possession closing clause in all 105 supplied complete records and all 690 explicitly enumerated purpose members; complete prefixes were read as interpretation context, not independently reapproved as unrelated prose.
scope.sourceInterpretation: acquire authors a holdingId formed from actor, artifactId, representationId and store. release names that one exact holdingId. In receipt-only delivery, acquire then release concerns the recipient message-inbox holding. Release does not transfer possession, publish/share/make content available, change permission/readability, destroy an artifact or delete every holding. The translation need not add every holdingId component absent from the English sentence, but must not contradict that targeted custody meaning.
